finding.title: Wait for the rebound audit before asserting on its count
finding.problem: The bounded wait observes only Bound and Available, then immediately assumes provider.rebound is already committed. Those are published by the independent handshake callback before the rebind coordinator necessarily wakes and emits its terminal audit. A valid production schedule therefore fails the immediate count assertion.
finding.minimumFix: Add presence of provider.rebound to the same bounded wait predicate, retaining the following exact len==1 and handshake==ready checks and all rejoin/high-risk/sensor assertions. Do not add unconditional sleep, swallow audit/assert errors, loosen len to>=1, or change production ordering.
finding.whyProductOrderingIsValid: Bound must precede Available so incoming session messages are not permanently gated. Provider availability is a transport/lifecycle fact, while provider.rebound records completion of the background lifecycle operation. No observed contract makes these publications one atomic transaction.

confirmedFacts.fact: Original GitHub Rust suite failure is exactly audit count0 versus1 at1631; the earlier Bound+Available wait did not fail. Suite result32passed/1failed,29.85s.
